input.overview: Complete the center red three-bank three times for the shortest Multiball route: the first completion opens the right outlane save gate, the second lights Collect Bonus there, and the third releases the right captive ball for Multiball. Along the way, complete upper 1-2-3 in order, then hit lit 4-5-6 targets to build Elektra units. Reach six units before the drain to enter the lower playfield, where ordered 1-2-3 or 4-5-6 followed by the flashing center target doubles bonus.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the center red three-bank three times; the third completion releases the right captive ball and starts Multiball. Complete upper 1-2-3 in order, then hit lit 4-5-6 targets to build at least six Elektra units and reach the lower playfield after the drain.
input.summary: Repeat the center red three-bank for the direct Multiball start, while building at least six Elektra units for the lower playfield. Use the lower ordered targets to double bonus.

steps.text: Complete the center red three-bank once to open the right outlane save gate and again to light Collect Bonus there.
Complete the center red three-bank a third time to release the right captive ball and start Multiball.
Complete upper 1-2-3 in order, then hit lit 4-5-6 targets to add Elektra units.
Reach at least six units before the drain; on the lower playfield, complete ordered 1-2-3 or 4-5-6, then hit the flashing center target to double bonus.

alternatives.title: Use the upper lock route
alternatives.when: Use this when upper 1-2-3 and 4-5-6 are already close.

steps.text: Complete upper 1-2-3 in order, qualify and finish 4-5-6, then shoot the lit upper saucer to lock a ball.
Repeat the qualification to release a captured ball and begin Multiball.

buildsToward.title: Enter the lower playfield with value

steps.text: Build six or more Elektra units and raise Bonus X with captive-ball hits before the drain.
Use the lower level's ordered targets for the bonus doubler instead of rushing the center target unqualified.

machineSetup: Confirm center-post behavior, ball count, lower-playfield access threshold, Extra Ball and Special conversions, and lock state.
Test all three levels, red and blue target banks, upper 1-2-3 and 4-5-6, both captive balls and locks, right gate, lower targets, and lifts.
